packscope.command.rescan: Packscope: cache cleared, scanning %s active resource packs again...
packscope.command.done: Packscope: %s resource packs, %s conflicts, %s completely covered. Report: %s
packscope.command.failed: Packscope: the report failed (%s). Details are in the log.
packscope.configuration.title: Packscope
packscope.configuration.showInVanillaScr: Icons in the vanilla pack screen
Show conflict icons in the vanilla resource pack screen.
packscope.configuration.showInPackedPack: Show conflict icons in the Packed Packs screen (only if Packed Packs is installed).
Byte-identical files are listed as harmless duplicates, not as conflicts.
packscope.configuration.showModOverrides: Show a grey info line "replaces X files of mods" in the icon tooltip.
packscope.configuration.ignoredPaths.too: Files that never count as a conflict, e.g. minecraft:textures/gui/title/*
packscope.configuration.previewSize.tool: Size of the texture preview in the detail screen, in pixels.
packscope.configuration.cacheEnabled.too: Keep scan results in memory and the checksums of folder packs in packscope/cache/.
packscope.configuration.autoExportReport: Write packscope/reports/packscope-report.md and .json after every resource reload.
packscope.configuration.reportListModOve: List all mod files in the report
List every replaced mod/vanilla file in the report, not only the numbers per mod.
